Three label-free independent experiments were performed using Cavβ2b-V5-APEX2-expressing cardiomyocytes
Digestion was performed overnight at 37°C with 30 µl of trypsin solution (0.006 µg/µl, Serva).
Label-free quantification of proteins was performed using MaxQuant
methionine oxidation and biotinylation as variable modifications
The protein bands were excised, hashed and destained
followed by a 1-min incubation with H2O2 at a final concentration of 1 mM
pre-incubated with 0.5 mM biotin-phenol in culture medium for 30 min at 37°C, followed by a 1-min incubation with H2O2
incubated with 50 μl of streptavidin-coated magnetic bead slurry for 3 h at 4°C
The samples eluted from the streptavidin-coated beads after enrichment of biotinylated proteins were loaded on a 12% polyacrylamide Bis-Tris gel
